title: Iran và Mỹ: Tensions Rekindle
source_summary: Quân đội Iran tuyên bố có khả năng xung đột giữa Iran và Mỹ tái bùng phát nếu lệnh ngừng bắn hết hạn, đồng thời cáo buộc Washington không cam kết bất kỳ thỏa thuận nào.

scenes.visual_prompt: A graphic timeline with red lines crossing over conflicting symbols representing Iran and the US, overlaid with text 'Tensions Rekindle'. The symbols are large and bold.
scenes.narration_text: The world watches as tensions between Iran and America escalate. A new warning from Iran's military looms ominously.
scenes.subtitle_text: Iran’s Military: High Risk of Renewed Clashes

scenes.visual_prompt: A tense scene with Iranian and American flag symbols in the background, both flags partially covered by smoke or dust.
scenes.narration_text: Iran's military is ready. They're prepared for any scenario if a ceasefire expires.

scenes.visual_prompt: A graphic of two hands shaking, representing the previous ceasefire agreement, with lines circling around them and breaking.
scenes.narration_text: But this handshake is about to break. The last ceasefire is on a countdown.

scenes.visual_prompt: A graphic of Iran and America flags intertwined with chains connecting them, symbolizing the conflict being tied up in knots.
scenes.narration_text: Iran accuses Washington. They say there's no commitment to any deal, leaving only uncertainty.

scenes.visual_prompt: A graphic of two hands with palm up signs (negotiation) and one hand with a clenched fist, representing Iran’s accusation of lack of commitment.
scenes.narration_text: Iran demands action. They accuse the US of no interest in any agreement.

scenes.visual_prompt: A graphic of two hands shaking with a hand extended, representing the need for renewed dialogue. The text 'Stay Tuned' is superimposed.
scenes.narration_text: As tensions rise, one thing remains clear: only continued monitoring will prevent another conflict.
